app.title: Shadow Lamp
app.subtitle: Lamp shades that project your image · STL for printing
app.description: Design lamp shades that project your image as a shadow and export them as STL for 3D printing.

image.title: Image
image.hint: Use black and white images. SVG gives cleaner edges; transparent areas count as white.
image.readError: The image could not be read

interpretation.title: Interpretation
interpretation.label: Black areas of the image will be
interpretation.hintLight: Black areas get lit: the lamp cuts them out as holes.
interpretation.hintShadow: Black areas stay in shadow: the lamp covers them with material.

position.title: Position on the wall
position.dragHint: Drag the image across the wall in the 3D view. Outside the image, the camera orbits as usual.

lamp.rimHint: The rim grows to cover the lip of the base and cap ({lip} mm + 1 mm).

bulb.title: Bulb
bulb.note: The bulb sits {depth} cm inside the shade. Holes are angled toward it so the wall thickness doesn't clip the shadow. A small LED gives sharper edges.

bridges.title: Bridges
bridges.hint: Bridges hold parts that would otherwise fall out (like the middle of an “O”).

partsTab.title: Snap-fit parts
partsTab.toggleHint: The base goes against the wall and holds the hollow bulb post (the cable runs inside). The cap closes the room side.
partsTab.clearanceHint: Gap between the lip and the shade. More clearance = looser fit.

export.coarsened: · cell enlarged to {cell} mm due to size
export.error: The STL could not be generated: {message}

viewer.moveImageTitle: Drag the image across the wall with the mouse
